narrative: On the almanack. The almanac lies open on the last day of June. The afternoon line is struck through. Two words are written across the space. Forty leaves sit beside the book, and no title is written on the struck line.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the two words and did not name the bill.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on almanac in Forty leaves, and No play
